stops.title: Ministri Tim dɛn
stops.caption: Ɛvri tim, ɛn udat de lid am.
stops.speech: Dipatmɛnt dɛn na di ministri tim dɛn. Ɛvri wan de sho in lida, in dɛpyuti, ɛn omɔch pipul de sav pan am.

stops.title: Insay wan Dipatmɛnt
stops.caption: Mɛmba lis, rota, rikrutmɛnt, yunifɔm.
stops.speech: Opin wan ɛn yu gɛt in mɛmba lis, in sav rota, di pipul we de aplay, ɛn di yunifɔm fɔ wan sɛvis we de kam.
